title: You Chose the Cross
lyrics: You c[Bb]hose the cross with every breath.
The p[Gm7]erfect life, the perfect death,[Eb2]
A c[Bb]rown of thorns You wore for us
And cr[Gm7]owned us with eternal life.[Eb2]
And t[Cm7]hough your soul was overw[Bb/D]helmed with [Fsus]pain,
I'm lost in w[Bb]onder. I'm lost [Gm7]in love.
